sheets.name: Warranty Reserve
rows: Warranty reserve at June 30, 2026: claims expected on the jobs completed in FY2026
Each job carries a one-year warranty from its completion. Account 2400, other accrued liabilities; entry AJ-26-0635.
Prepared by Dana Whitfield, Controller, on July 16, 2026. Demonstration document.
Basis: Claims expected job by job from each superintendent’s open punch list and callbacks at June 30, 2026. The 1% of completed contracts used through FY2023 was replaced by this estimate in FY2024.
Corridor finish callbacks, floors 7 to 9; roof drain repairs
Gym floor and HVAC balancing callbacks
Overhead door adjustments and slab joint sealing
Corliss Medical Group clinic tenant improvement
Disputed change order work; owner’s punch list not signed off
Unit punch lists and window flashing callbacks
